headline: Going Commando adds 30 functions across setup, rewards and effects
summary: Going Commando gains 30 function matches for USA v1.01 across three pull requests. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. They cover shared game routines and level setup, state and effects, while the unchanged 6.51% progress report has not yet counted this work.
highlights: #208 adds 21 level functions, including Barlow and Joba setup and Damosel state changes.
Its effects work spans Oozla, Notak, Tabora, Joba, Aranos Prison, Gorn, Damosel and Yeedil.
#207 and #209 add nine shared game functions, with boot and all 27 levels verified byte-identical.
